My Name is Sahej and I had been suffering from severe back pain since August 2025. Over the course of several months, I consulted two different clinics. While the medications prescribed provided temporary relief, the pain would inevitably return, leaving me frustrated and concerned about my long-term recovery.

Determined to seek a more sustainable solution, I decided to explore physiotherapy. After conducting research, I came across Dr. Gunjan Gupta Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Centre, conveniently located near me. I scheduled a visit the very same day.

During my initial consultation, Dr. Gunjan advised that a structured course of 20 physiotherapy sessions would be necessary for effective recovery. She also recommended certain medications. Initially, I was hesitant, as I had previously relied on medicines without lasting results. However, I decided to place my trust in her expertise and proceed with the treatment plan.

From the very first few sessions, the approach was markedly different. Rather than depending solely on medication, Dr. Gunjan focused extensively on guided therapeutic exercises tailored specifically to my condition. Gradually, I began to observe measurable improvement. My pain intensity, which had been at an unbearable 10/10, reduced significantly to 2–3/10 within the initial sessions.

Encouraged by this progress, I cautiously resumed walking and eventually running—activities I had been completely unable to perform for months. Now, after completing 19 sessions, I can confidently state that I am almost fully recovered. My back pain has diminished from 10/10 to an almost negligible 0.5/10 on the pain scale.

Beyond the clinical excellence, the overall environment of the centre is exceptionally calm and welcoming. The ambience is soothing, and both Dr. Gunjan and her colleague demonstrate remarkable professionalism, empathy, and dedication toward patient care.

I wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Gunjan Gupta Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Centre to anyone seeking a long-term, structured, and effective solution for musculoskeletal pain. My experience has been transformative, and I am deeply grateful for the care and guidance I received.
